service.description: Correct or update details on the voter ID — name, age, address, photo, relative's name (Form 8). Also used to shift to a new address.
service.depending: Voter ID (EPIC) number, proof of the corrected detail, new address proof (for a shift), passport size photo (for a photo change)
service.rules: Only the ticked details are changed. Give the reference number to the customer.
